name: Rauthy
description: Rust identity provider supporting OpenID Connect, OAuth 2, and passkeys. Native service with embedded Hiqlite storage; requires an HTTPS reverse proxy.

notes.text: Requires a public DNS hostname and a browser-trusted HTTPS reverse proxy on port 443. Configure the proxy before first login; TLS and proxy are external.

Builds native Rauthy from official release source with the archived upstream frontend. Defaults reserve resources for compilation. Real AMD64 Proxmox testing is pending; the source build on ARM64 is untested.
Initial administrator password is random and stored in the root-only /opt/rauthy_data/config.toml. Change it after first login, then remove bootstrap.password_plain.
